src/sqllens/agent/core/enhancer/default.py:104-110,127-139 confirm both parts of AC6. Lines 133-139: band_pairs = [r for r in tool_hits if r.similarity_score < strict and isinstance(r.memory.args, dict) and r.memory.args.get('sql')] — pairs with similarity_score >= strict (== similarity_threshold) are excluded from band_pairs, i.e. excluded from injection, remaining reusable only through the tool-search path (search_similar_usage), matching the claim. Lines 104-110: strict = self.similarity_threshold; context_floor = self.context_similarity_threshold; text_search_floor = min(context_floor, strict) — a min() can never exceed strict, so the floor passed to search_text_memories (line 119) never rises above strict; text memories scoring >= strict continue to pass the similarity_threshold=text_search_floor filter exactly as they did when the floor was strict, preserving prior injection behavior for those at/above strict.
